claims.claim: 0.4.1 adds optional per-vault color group preservation, including Mono and preview; default off, no recovery of earlier groups.
Built-in presets preserve physics and sizes. Custom presets can save physics and optional filters. PNG export supports 2D global and local graphs; Restore restores the first backup.
Experimental 3D has Force, Orbital and Globe layouts, Original and Deep Space looks, and snapshot-based global filters with limited group-query support.
Graph color probes, view-content iframe filters and input pass-through selectors match the released CSS generator; manual snippets depend on private app internals.
0.4.2 adds Start/Pause rotation and Refresh from 2D graph; refresh resets the camera and graph filters do not synchronize live. Existing guide captures remain 0.4.1.
